name: epicatechin gallate
summary: Gallated catechin from tea with anti-inflammatory signaling effects.
description: Epicatechin gallate (EGCG-like catechin gallate) from tea can modulate inflammatory signaling while supporting antioxidant defenses in cells exposed to oxidative stress.
safetyNotes: Tea-food exposure is generally safer than concentrated extracts. High EGCG/catechin extracts have liver-injury concern and caffeine-containing products add stimulant risk.
evidenceLevel: Editorial grade not demonstrated by recorded studies
evidence_tier: Editorial grade not demonstrated by recorded studies
evidenceTier: Editorial grade not demonstrated by recorded studies
